beats.summary: Michael announces an obesity weight loss challenge at work and encourages everyone to lose five pounds.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Thank you. Holly is right. People, this is not just about winning some extra vacation days. This is about a very cool HR initiative that if we don't follow, we are all going to die of obesity.
Michael: This is how we're gonna do it. Five pounds. I'm asking each of you to lose five pounds.

beats.summary: Andy expresses his commitment to marry Angela regardless of the wedding location.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Sweetheart. Just so you know, I don't care where we get married. I'll marry you right here in this building.

beats.summary: Michael hosts a party that is considered lame, and later a mini-golf outing is planned but Holly has a date.

evidence.snippet: Michael (music playing): It's a pretty lame party.

beats.summary: The office weight loss challenge is not going well, and corporate increases the prize to five days off to motivate participants.

evidence.snippet: Holly: It's kind of a good news, bad news situation. The bad news is we're not doing very well, so we really had to starve ourselves this whole week.

beats.summary: Kelly reveals she swallowed a tapeworm to lose weight, but Creed claims it was not a tapeworm.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: I swallowed a tapeworm last night. It's going to grow up to three feet inside of me and then it eats all my food so that I don't get fat.

beats.summary: Ryan returns to the office with a grudge list and apologizes to Jim, but his sincerity is questionable.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: I'm keeping a list… of everyone who wrongs me.
Ryan: Jim. I wanted to apologize… for how I treated you last year.
